12.text: I mistyped one digit of a phone number and sent $269 to the wrong person. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

I accidentally sent $79 to a stranger with the same name as my friend. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. The recipient will not respond and the company refuses to contact them. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

The app autofilled the wrong contact and my payment of $1,255 went to someone I do not know. The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. There was no confirmation showing the recipient's full name before I sent it. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

5.text: A person posing as my utility company told me to pay $74 through the app or my power would be shut off today. When I filed a claim they told me peer to peer payments are not covered by purchase protection and closed the case. There was no warning in the app before I sent the money even though the recipient account was brand new.
